question.text:
What is the squared distance from (2, 3, 2) to the closed segment joining (1, 0, 0) and (1, 2, 0)?
(A) 1 (B) 5 (C) 6 (D) 9 (E) 14

solution.text:
2
A point of the segment is (1, 2t, 0) with 0 ≤ t ≤ 1. Its squared distance is 5 + (3 − 2t) . The
unrestricted minimizer t = 3/2 lies outside the segment, so the segment minimum occurs at
t = 1 and equals 6. The containing line would instead give squared distance 5.
